{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies the libbitcoinkernel public C API in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h and implementation in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp, replacing string log callbacks with structured btck_LogEntry objects.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "This PR provides substantial durable value to downstream consumers by replacing brittle string parsing with structured log objects and removing logging.cpp from the kernel library. Delivering message contents, thread names, timestamps, and levels directly in btck_LogEntry eliminates the need for consumers to parse strings ('cumbersome, brittle, and inefficient'), advances decoupling of node internals from the kernel, and enables subsequent kernel refactors #30342 and #33847."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Incidental kernel unit test updates in src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp and a sanitizer suppression addition in test/sanitizer_suppressions/valgrind.supp follow directly from the kernel API change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes to test files are mechanical updates adapting the kernel test harness to the new logging interface rather than general test framework improvements."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Mechanical update in src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp (+5/-12) to adapt the example executable to the updated kernel logging C API.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Editing the bitcoin-chainstate example tool is purely incidental to the kernel logging refactor."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications touch src/logging.h (-1 line) and implement a specialized KernelLogger backend for util/log.h hooks solely for the kernel boundary.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The category explicitly excludes changes whose primary subject is the kernel API."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Labeled Validation, but the category scope explicitly excludes PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not modify validation logic or chainstate consensus rules, touching only the kernel API and its logging infrastructure."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
